subject: Physics
title: Work, Energy and Power
summary: Kaam (work) tab hota hai jab force ke direction mein displacement ho: W = F·s = Fs cosθ. Force perpendicular ho (circular motion mein centripetal, normal force) to kaam zero. Kaam negative bhi ho sakta hai (friction).
Work–energy theorem sabse bada shortcut hai: SAARE forces ka kaam = KE ka badlaav. Isse force ke time-dependence mein jaaye bina speed nikal jaati hai.

Conservative force (gravity, spring, electric) ka kaam path par depend nahi karta aur iske liye potential energy U define hoti hai: F = −dU/dx. Sirf conservative forces kaam karein to mechanical energy (KE + PE) constant rehti hai. Friction non-conservative hai — energy heat ban jaati hai.

Power = kaam karne ki rate, P = dW/dt = F·v. Collision mein momentum hamesha conserve (agar external force nahi), lekin KE sirf elastic collision mein; coefficient of restitution e batata hai takkar kitni elastic thi.

formulas.name: Work by a constant force
formulas.formula: W = F·s = Fs cosθ = F_x s_x + F_y s_y + F_z s_z
formulas.mistake: θ force aur DISPLACEMENT ke beech ka angle hai, force aur surface ke beech ka nahi.

formulas.name: Work by a variable force
formulas.formula: W = ∫F dx = F–x graph ke neeche ka area
formulas.when: Force position ke saath badle (spring, F = kx²).
formulas.note: Graph mein x-axis ke neeche ka area negative kaam hai.

formulas.name: Kinetic energy
formulas.mistake: Same momentum par halki body ki KE zyada hoti hai — ulta mat socho.

formulas.name: Work–energy theorem
formulas.when: Friction, air resistance, variable force ke saath speed.
formulas.mistake: SAARE forces ka kaam jodo (gravity, friction, normal, applied), sirf ek ka nahi.

formulas.name: Gravitational potential energy (near earth)
formulas.mistake: Reference level kahin bhi lo, ΔU same aata hai — absolute U ka matlab nahi.

formulas.name: Spring potential energy
formulas.formula: F = −kx;   U = ½kx²;   x₁ se x₂ tak spring ka kaam = ½k(x₁² − x₂²)
formulas.mistake: x natural length se naapo, poori lambai nahi.

formulas.name: Force from potential energy
formulas.formula: F = −dU/dx;   equilibrium: dU/dx = 0;   stable: d²U/dx² > 0, unstable: < 0
formulas.mistake: Minus sign bhool jaate hain: force U ghatne ki direction mein lagta hai.

formulas.name: Conservation of mechanical energy
formulas.formula: K_i + U_i = K_f + U_f  (sirf conservative forces kaam karein)
formulas.mistake: Friction ho to yeh seedha nahi lagta — W_friction ko jodo.

formulas.name: Power
formulas.formula: P_avg = W/t;   P = dW/dt = F·v = Fv cosθ;   1 hp = 746 W
formulas.mistake: kWh energy ki unit hai, power ki nahi (1 kWh = 3.6 × 10⁶ J).

formulas.name: Vertical circle (string)
formulas.formula: Bottom par min speed √(5gl);  top par min √(gl);  T_bottom − T_top = 6mg
formulas.when: String se bandhi ball ka poora chakkar.
formulas.mistake: Rod (string nahi) ho to top par min speed 0 aur bottom par √(4gl).

formulas.name: Elastic collision in 1-D
formulas.formula: v₁ = [(m₁ − m₂)u₁ + 2m₂u₂]/(m₁ + m₂);   v₂ = [(m₂ − m₁)u₂ + 2m₁u₁]/(m₁ + m₂)
formulas.mistake: Equal masses mein velocities exchange ho jaati hain — formula lagaane ki zaroorat nahi.

formulas.name: Perfectly inelastic collision
formulas.formula: v = (m₁u₁ + m₂u₂)/(m₁ + m₂);   KE loss = m₁m₂(u₁ − u₂)² / [2(m₁ + m₂)]
formulas.mistake: KE conserve maan lena galat — momentum hi conserve hai.

formulas.name: Coefficient of restitution
formulas.formula: e = (separation speed)/(approach speed) = (v₂ − v₁)/(u₁ − u₂);   e = 1 elastic, e = 0 perfectly inelastic
formulas.mistake: Velocities ke sign dhyan se — approach aur separation dono positive lo.

formulas.name: Bouncing ball
formulas.formula: Rebound height h₁ = e²h;   nth rebound hₙ = e²ⁿh
formulas.mistake: Speed e guna hoti hai, height e² guna — dono mix mat karo.

formulas.name: Collision in 2-D
formulas.formula: Har direction mein alag: Σp_x conserve, Σp_y conserve.  Equal masses, elastic, ek rest par ⇒ baad mein 90° par alag
formulas.mistake: Speed ko seedha jodna galat — vector (components) mein jodo.

examples.title: Dot product se kaam
examples.problem: F = (3î + 4ĵ) N, displacement s = (2î + ĵ) m. Kaam?

examples.title: Variable force
examples.problem: F = 3x² N (x metre mein). x = 0 se 2 m tak kaam?

examples.title: Spring se block
examples.problem: k = 200 N/m wala spring 0.1 m compress karke 0.5 kg block chhoda (smooth floor). Spring energy aur block ki speed?

examples.title: Motor ki power
examples.problem: Motor 100 kg ko 2 m/s ki constant speed se upar uthata hai (g = 10). Power?
examples.solution: Constant speed ⇒ F = mg = 1000 N. P = Fv = 1000 × 2 = 2000 W (≈ 2.7 hp).

examples.title: Vertical circle
examples.problem: 1 m lambi string se bandhi 0.5 kg ball ko vertical circle poora karna hai (g = 10). Bottom aur top par min speed, aur tension ka fark?
examples.solution: Bottom: √(5gl) = √50 ≈ 7.07 m/s. Top: √(gl) = √10 ≈ 3.16 m/s. T_bottom − T_top = 6mg = 30 N.

examples.title: Elastic takkar
examples.problem: 2 kg block 3 m/s se rest par rakhe 1 kg block se elastic takkar karta hai. Dono ki final velocity?

examples.title: Chipakne wali takkar
examples.problem: 2 kg block 3 m/s se rest par rakhe 1 kg se takrakar chipak jaata hai. Common velocity aur KE loss?
examples.solution: v = 6/3 = 2 m/s. KE pehle 9 J, baad mein ½ × 3 × 4 = 6 J ⇒ loss = 3 J (heat/sound).

examples.title: Uchhalti ball
examples.problem: Ball 5 m se giri, e = 0.6. Pehli rebound height?

examples.title: Friction se rukna
examples.problem: 2 kg block 10 m/s se rough floor (μ_k = 0.25) par phisalta hai. Kitni door jaake rukega?
examples.solution: Work–energy: μmg·s = ½mv² ⇒ s = v²/(2μg) = 100/5 = 20 m. (Mass cancel.)

examples.title: 2-D chipakne wali takkar
examples.problem: 2 kg body 3 m/s se east aur 3 kg body 2 m/s se north mein takrakar chipak jaati hain. Final velocity?
examples.solution: p_x = 6, p_y = 6 kg·m/s ⇒ v = √(36 + 36)/5 ≈ 1.7 m/s, direction east se 45° north ki taraf.

examples.title: Air resistance ka kaam
examples.problem: 2 kg patthar 5 m upar se gira aur zameen par 8 m/s se pahuncha (g = 10). Air resistance ne kitna kaam kiya?
examples.solution: W_gravity = mgh = 100 J. ΔK = ½ × 2 × 64 = 64 J. W_air = 64 − 100 = −36 J (negative — energy cheeni).

topics.title: Kaam kab zero, positive, negative
topics.explain: θ < 90° positive (force motion mein madad), θ = 90° zero (normal force, centripetal force, coolie sir par bojh lekar horizontal chale to gravity ka kaam), θ > 90° negative (friction, upar phenki ball par gravity).

topics.title: Kinetic aur potential energy
topics.explain: KE motion ki energy, hamesha ≥ 0. PE position/configuration ki energy (height, spring ka khinchav) — sirf conservative force ke liye define hoti hai. Unit joule; 1 eV = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J.

topics.title: Work–energy theorem
topics.explain: Net kaam = ΔKE. Yeh Newton ke doosre niyam ka integral roop hai. Variable force, curved path, friction — sab mein speed nikalne ka sabse fast tarika.

topics.title: Conservative vs non-conservative forces
topics.explain: Conservative: kaam path-independent, closed loop mein kaam zero, PE define hoti hai (gravity, spring, electrostatic). Non-conservative: kaam path par depend, energy heat mein jaati hai (friction, air drag, viscous force).

topics.title: Potential energy of a spring
topics.explain: Spring ko x khinchne mein kaam ½kx² lagta hai jo PE ban kar store hota hai. Spring force restoring hai (F = −kx). Do springs: series mein 1/k = 1/k₁ + 1/k₂, parallel mein k = k₁ + k₂.

topics.title: Motion in a vertical circle
topics.explain: Upar jaate hue speed ghatti hai (KE → PE). String slack na ho iske liye top par T ≥ 0 ⇒ v_top ≥ √(gl), aur energy se v_bottom ≥ √(5gl). Horizontal position par tension = mv²/l.

topics.title: Collisions: elastic aur inelastic
topics.explain: Har collision mein (external force na ho to) momentum conserve. Elastic mein KE bhi conserve (e = 1) — atomic/ideal billiard. Inelastic mein KE ka kuch hissa heat/sound/deformation. Perfectly inelastic mein bodies chipak jaati hain aur max KE loss hota hai.

topics.title: Collisions in two dimensions
topics.explain: x aur y momentum alag-alag conserve karo. Equal masses ka elastic oblique collision (ek rest par) — dono 90° par alag hote hain (billiards). Head-on (1-D) mein sab ek line par.

ratta: Perfectly inelastic: max KE loss, e = 0.
